name: AI Prompt Manager
desc: Save, organize, and quickly reuse AI prompts. Categorize by model, tag system, search/filter, export to markdown, copy to clipboard. Full terminal UI.

name: Bulk Image Resizer
desc: Resize hundreds of images at once. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF. Progress bar, folder watch mode, quality settings.

name: auto-vpn-killswitch
desc: Sets up a VPN killswitch on Linux using iptables/nftables. If VPN drops, all internet traffic is blocked until VPN reconnects. Features: supports WireGuard and OpenVPN, killswitch on/off toggle, status monitoring, auto-reconnect, logging, desktop notifications. One-command install.

name: bash-obfuscator
desc: Obfuscates bash scripts by: variable name randomization, base64 encoding of strings, comment stripping, code flattening, dead code injection. Output is a functionally identical but unreadable .sh file. Includes a simple GUI mode with zenity.
